title: Long types
summary: A type too long for one line is written in lines of at most 60 columns
prose: A part that does not fit is named by a Greek letter and spelled on its own line below, two columns further in; a part written twice shares its letter. A list of arguments or parameters that still does not fit wraps after its bracket.

Dispatch dispatch

`Dispatch` is
```cpp
((α, β, γ, δ, ε, ζ, η, θ, …) -> void)*
  α = ((int) -> void)*
  β = ((long) -> void)*
  γ = ((char) -> void)*
  δ = ((short) -> void)*
  ε = ((float) -> void)*
  ζ = ((double) -> void)*
  η = ((bool) -> void)*
  θ = ((unsigned int) -> void)*
```
